```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)



abundance_df <- read_delim("data/newpicrust2_out_pipeline-20251218/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat_metacyc.tsv",
  delim = "\t", col_names = TRUE, escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE
)


metadata <- read.csv("data\\KK-Brittany-sample info sheet June2023.csv")


output_dir <- "R_output"  # main folder
output_ord <- file.path(output_dir, "PICRUSt2_ordination")
if (dir.exists(output_ord)) unlink(output_ord, recursive = TRUE)
# Create a fresh folder
dir.create(output_ord, recursive = TRUE)

```

```{r}

# Replace dots with underscores
names(metadata) <- gsub("\\.", "_", names(metadata))

# Remove trailing underscores (1 or more)
names(metadata) <- gsub("_+$", "", names(metadata))

# Proceed with modifying data
metadata$Lifestage <- factor(metadata$Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult", "Spider"),ordered = FALSE)

contrasts(metadata$Lifestage) <- contr.treatment(3)


abundance_samples <- colnames(abundance_df)[-1]   # remove "function."

metadata <- metadata[metadata$Study_ID %in% abundance_samples, ]

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Study_ID

# Factor assignments
metadata$Lifestage <- factor(metadata$Lifestage)
metadata$Taxa <- factor(metadata$Taxa)
metadata$Location <- factor(metadata$Location)
metadata$Site <- factor(metadata$Site)


# Set pathway as rownames and transpose
abundance_mat <- abundance_df %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "description") %>%  # pathways as rownames
  t() %>%                                  # transpose to samples x features
  as.data.frame()

# Convert all columns to numeric after transposing
abundance_mat <- abundance_mat %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# Keep only samples present in metadata
abundance_mat <- abundance_mat[rownames(metadata), ]


# TSS normalization 
abundance_tss <- sweep(abundance_mat, 1, rowSums(abundance_mat), FUN = "/")
bray_dist <- vegdist(abundance_tss, method = "bray")
pcoa_res <- ape::pcoa(bray_dist)

# Extract first two axes
pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

# Add metadata
pcoa_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_df)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, metadata, by = c("Sample_ID" = "Study_ID"))

# % variance explained
var_exp <- round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)

```

## PERMANOVA

PERMANOVA formula explanation:

Formula used: bray_dist \~ Taxa/Lifestage + Location Strata: Site

**Rationale**:

*- Taxa: Broad organism group (e.g., microbes, macroinvertebrates). - Lifestage: Nested within Taxa (e.g., larvae vs adult), specified as 'Taxa/Lifestage'. This tests for differences among lifestages while accounting for variation among taxa.*

*- Location: Upstream vs downstream sampling points relative to anthropogenic impacts. This factor tests whether community or functional composition differs along the gradient.*

*- Strata = Site: Restricts permutations within each site to account for repeated measures or spatial variability. This ensures the permutation test respects the hierarchical structure of the data.*

**Notes:**

*- Using 'by = "margin"' ensures each factor's R² and p-value reflects its independent contribution to variation, regardless of order.*

*- The nested structure (lifestage within taxa) is maintained in the model.*

**Outcome:**

*- R²: proportion of variance explained by each factor.*

*- p-values: significance from permutation tests, indicating whether observed differences are unlikely by chance.*

```{r}
adonis<-adonis2(
  bray_dist ~ Taxa/Lifestage + Location,
  data = metadata,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin",
  strata = metadata$Site
)

print(adonis)
```

# Create for each taxon

```{r}
# Create a PCoA output folder (inside your ordination folder)
output_pcoa_by_taxa <- file.path(output_ord, "PCoA_by_Taxa")
if (dir.exists(output_pcoa_by_taxa)) unlink(output_pcoa_by_taxa, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(output_pcoa_by_taxa, recursive = TRUE)

# Safety: ensure factors exist and are consistent
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa      = factor(Taxa),
    Location  = factor(Location),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage),
    Site      = factor(Site)
  )

# Function: run PCoA for one taxon and save plot(s)
run_pcoa_for_taxon <- function(taxon_name,
                              metadata,
                              abundance_mat,
                              out_base,
                              min_samples = 6,
                              min_groups_per_location = 2) {

  # subset metadata
  meta_sub <- metadata %>% filter(Taxa == taxon_name)

  # require enough samples
  if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
    message("Skipping ", taxon_name, " (n=", nrow(meta_sub), " < ", min_samples, ")")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # subset abundance matrix (keep only those samples)
  abundance_sub <- abundance_mat[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  # drop all-zero pathways (helps with distances)
  keep_cols <- colSums(abundance_sub, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  abundance_sub <- abundance_sub[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # remove samples with zero total counts (avoid division by zero)
  rs <- rowSums(abundance_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep_rows <- rs > 0
  meta_sub <- meta_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  abundance_sub <- abundance_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
    message("Skipping ", taxon_name, " after filtering zeros (n=", nrow(meta_sub), ")")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Create taxon folder
  taxon_safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]", "_", as.character(taxon_name))
  out_dir <- file.path(out_base, taxon_safe)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # TSS normalize
  abundance_tss <- sweep(abundance_sub, 1, rowSums(abundance_sub), FUN = "/")

  # Bray-Curtis + PCoA
  bray_dist <- vegdist(abundance_tss, method = "bray")
  pcoa_res <- ape::pcoa(bray_dist)

  # Extract axes
  pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
  colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  pcoa_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_df)

  # join metadata
  meta_sub$Sample_ID <- rownames(meta_sub)
  pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, meta_sub, by = "Sample_ID")

  # variance explained
  var_exp <- round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)

  # Decide whether to draw ellipses (need enough points per Location)
  loc_counts <- table(pcoa_df$Location)
  draw_ellipses <- all(loc_counts >= min_groups_per_location)

  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Location, shape = Lifestage)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("PCoA (Bray–Curtis) – MetaCyc (PICRUSt2), ", taxon_name),
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
    )

  if (draw_ellipses) {
    p <- p + stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location), type = "t", level = 0.95)
  }

  # Save plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("PCoA_", taxon_safe, "_loc_color_lifestage_shape.png"),
    plot = p,
    path = out_dir,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  #small PERMANOVA summary for Location within this taxon
  # NOTE: adonis2 wants a dist object and a data.frame with matching rows
  perm <- tryCatch({
    adonis2(bray_dist ~ Location, data = meta_sub, strata = meta_sub$Site, permutations = 999)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (!is.null(perm)) {
    write.csv(
      as.data.frame(perm),
      file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("PERMANOVA_Location_", taxon_safe, ".csv")),
      row.names = TRUE
    )
  }

  return(invisible(list(plot = p, pcoa = pcoa_res, pcoa_df = pcoa_df, perm = perm)))
}

# -----------------------------
# Run loop over taxa
# -----------------------------
taxa_list <- sort(unique(as.character(metadata$Taxa)))
results_list <- vector("list", length(taxa_list))
names(results_list) <- taxa_list

for (tx in taxa_list) {
  results_list[[tx]] <- run_pcoa_for_taxon(
    taxon_name  = tx,
    metadata    = metadata,
    abundance_mat = abundance_mat,
    out_base    = output_pcoa_by_taxa,
    min_samples = 6
  )
}

message("Done. Saved to: ", output_pcoa_by_taxa)
```

### Looking at Hydropsychidae outliers

```{r}

# Single-taxon PCoA (Bray–Curtis) with and without outliers + Outlier metadata table export


# -----------------------------
# USER SETTINGS
# -----------------------------
taxon_name <- "Hydropsychidae" 
min_samples <- 6                 # minimum samples to run ordination
outlier_quantile <- 0.95         # for centroid-distance outliers (e.g., 0.95 or 0.97)


output_base <- file.path("R_output", "PICRUSt2_ordination", "PCoA_single_taxon_outliers")
if (dir.exists(output_base)) unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE)


# Subset to the single taxon

meta_sub <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa      = as.character(Taxa),
    Study_ID  = as.character(Study_ID),
    Location  = factor(Location),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage),
    Site      = factor(Site)
  ) %>%
  filter(Taxa == taxon_name) %>%
  filter(Study_ID %in% rownames(abundance_mat))

if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
  stop("Not enough samples for taxon: ", taxon_name, " (n=", nrow(meta_sub), ")")
}

meta_sub <- as.data.frame(meta_sub)
rownames(meta_sub) <- meta_sub$Study_ID

abund_sub <- abundance_mat[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

# Drop pathways that are all-zero within this taxon
keep_cols <- colSums(abund_sub, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
abund_sub <- abund_sub[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Drop samples with zero total (avoid divide-by-zero)
rs <- rowSums(abund_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_rows <- rs > 0
abund_sub <- abund_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub  <- meta_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
  stop("Not enough nonzero samples for taxon after filtering: ", taxon_name,
       " (n=", nrow(meta_sub), ")")
}


# Compute PCoA (WITH all samples)
abund_tss <- sweep(abund_sub, 1, rowSums(abund_sub), FUN = "/")
bray_dist <- vegdist(abund_tss, method = "bray")
pcoa_res  <- ape::pcoa(bray_dist)

pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_df)

meta_sub$Sample_ID <- rownames(meta_sub)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, meta_sub, by = "Sample_ID")

var_exp <- round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)


#  Identify outliers in PCoA space (distance from centroid)
centroid <- colMeans(pcoa_df[, c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")], na.rm = TRUE)

pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid <- sqrt(
  (pcoa_df$PCoA1 - centroid["PCoA1"])^2 +
  (pcoa_df$PCoA2 - centroid["PCoA2"])^2
)

threshold <- as.numeric(quantile(pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid, outlier_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
pcoa_df$outlier <- pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid > threshold

# Outlier list (coords + key metadata)
outliers <- pcoa_df %>%
  filter(outlier) %>%
  arrange(desc(Distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  select(
    Sample_ID, Distance_to_centroid, PCoA1, PCoA2,
    Location, Lifestage, Site, everything()
  )

# Save outlier table
write.csv(outliers,
          file = file.path(output_base, paste0("OUTLIERS_", taxon_name, "_centroidDist.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Also save a minimal outlier summary (only most relevant fields)
outliers_min <- outliers %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Distance_to_centroid, Location, Lifestage, Site)

write.csv(outliers_min,
          file = file.path(output_base, paste0("OUTLIERS_", taxon_name, "_MIN.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)


# Plot WITH outliers (Location color, Lifestage shape)
p_with <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Location, shape = Lifestage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location), type = "t", level = 0.95) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCoA (Bray–Curtis) – MetaCyc (PICRUSt2), ", taxon_name, " (with outliers)"),
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("PCoA_", taxon_name, "_WITH_outliers.png"),
  plot = p_with,
  path = output_base,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)


#  Remove outliers and recompute PCoA (NO outliers)
outlier_ids <- outliers$Sample_ID

meta_no_out <- meta_sub[!rownames(meta_sub) %in% outlier_ids, , drop = FALSE]
abund_no_out <- abund_sub[rownames(meta_no_out), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(meta_no_out) < min_samples) {
  stop("Too few samples after removing outliers (n=", nrow(meta_no_out), ").")
}

# TSS normalize + Bray–Curtis
abund_no_out_tss <- sweep(abund_no_out, 1, rowSums(abund_no_out), FUN = "/")
bray_no_out <- vegdist(abund_no_out_tss, method = "bray")
pcoa_no_out <- ape::pcoa(bray_no_out)

pcoa_no_out_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_no_out$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_no_out_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_no_out_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_no_out_df)

meta_no_out$Sample_ID <- rownames(meta_no_out)
pcoa_no_out_df <- left_join(pcoa_no_out_df, meta_no_out, by = "Sample_ID")

var_exp_no_out <- round(pcoa_no_out$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)


# Plot WITHOUT outlier
p_no_out <- ggplot(pcoa_no_out_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Location, shape = Lifestage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location), type = "t", level = 0.95) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCoA (Bray–Curtis) – MetaCyc (PICRUSt2), ", taxon_name, " (outliers removed)"),
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp_no_out[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp_no_out[2], "%)")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("PCoA_", taxon_name, "_NO_outliers.png"),
  plot = p_no_out,
  path = output_base,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)


# PERMANOVA Location with vs without outliers (strata = Site)
perm_with <- tryCatch(
  adonis2(bray_dist ~ Location, data = meta_sub, strata = meta_sub$Site, permutations = 999),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

perm_no_out <- tryCatch(
  adonis2(bray_no_out ~ Location, data = meta_no_out, strata = meta_no_out$Site, permutations = 999),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(perm_with)) {
  write.csv(as.data.frame(perm_with),
            file = file.path(output_base, paste0("PERMANOVA_Location_WITH_outliers_", taxon_name, ".csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
}

if (!is.null(perm_no_out)) {
  write.csv(as.data.frame(perm_no_out),
            file = file.path(output_base, paste0("PERMANOVA_Location_NO_outliers_", taxon_name, ".csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
}


message("Saved outputs to: ", output_base)
message("Outlier threshold (", outlier_quantile * 100, "th percentile) = ", round(threshold, 4))
message("N outliers = ", nrow(outliers))

# Print in console
print(outliers_min)

# Show plots 
p_with
p_no_out

```

### Chironomidae with/without outliers

```{r}
# Single-taxon PCoA (Bray–Curtis) with and without outliers + Outlier metadata table export


library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)


taxon_name <- "Chironomidae"   
min_samples <- 6                 # minimum samples to run ordination
outlier_quantile <- 0.95         # for centroid-distance outliers (e.g., 0.95 or 0.97)


output_base <- file.path("R_output", "PICRUSt2_ordination", "PCoA_single_taxon_outliers")
if (dir.exists(output_base)) unlink(output_base, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(output_base, recursive = TRUE)


#Subset to the single taxon
meta_sub <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa      = as.character(Taxa),
    Study_ID  = as.character(Study_ID),
    Location  = factor(Location),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage),
    Site      = factor(Site)
  ) %>%
  filter(Taxa == taxon_name) %>%
  filter(Study_ID %in% rownames(abundance_mat))

if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
  stop("Not enough samples for taxon: ", taxon_name, " (n=", nrow(meta_sub), ")")
}

meta_sub <- as.data.frame(meta_sub)
rownames(meta_sub) <- meta_sub$Study_ID

abund_sub <- abundance_mat[rownames(meta_sub), , drop = FALSE]

# Drop pathways that are all-zero within this taxon
keep_cols <- colSums(abund_sub, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
abund_sub <- abund_sub[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Drop samples with zero total (avoid divide-by-zero)
rs <- rowSums(abund_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_rows <- rs > 0
abund_sub <- abund_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub  <- meta_sub[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(meta_sub) < min_samples) {
  stop("Not enough nonzero samples for taxon after filtering: ", taxon_name,
       " (n=", nrow(meta_sub), ")")
}


# Compute PCoA (WITH all samples)
abund_tss <- sweep(abund_sub, 1, rowSums(abund_sub), FUN = "/")
bray_dist <- vegdist(abund_tss, method = "bray")
pcoa_res  <- ape::pcoa(bray_dist)

pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_df)

meta_sub$Sample_ID <- rownames(meta_sub)
pcoa_df <- left_join(pcoa_df, meta_sub, by = "Sample_ID")

var_exp <- round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)


# Identify outliers in PCoA space (distance from centroid)
centroid <- colMeans(pcoa_df[, c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")], na.rm = TRUE)

pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid <- sqrt(
  (pcoa_df$PCoA1 - centroid["PCoA1"])^2 +
  (pcoa_df$PCoA2 - centroid["PCoA2"])^2
)

threshold <- as.numeric(quantile(pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid, outlier_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
pcoa_df$outlier <- pcoa_df$Distance_to_centroid > threshold

# Outlier list (coords + key metadata)
outliers <- pcoa_df %>%
  filter(outlier) %>%
  arrange(desc(Distance_to_centroid)) %>%
  select(
    Sample_ID, Distance_to_centroid, PCoA1, PCoA2,
    Location, Lifestage, Site, everything()
  )

# Save outlier table
write.csv(outliers,
          file = file.path(output_base, paste0("OUTLIERS_", taxon_name, "_centroidDist.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Also save a minimal outlier summary (only most relevant fields)
outliers_min <- outliers %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Distance_to_centroid, Location, Lifestage, Site)

write.csv(outliers_min,
          file = file.path(output_base, paste0("OUTLIERS_", taxon_name, "_MIN.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

#lot WITH outliers (Location color, Lifestage shape)
p_with <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Location, shape = Lifestage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location), type = "t", level = 0.95) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCoA (Bray–Curtis) – MetaCyc (PICRUSt2), ", taxon_name, " (with outliers)"),
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("PCoA_", taxon_name, "_WITH_outliers.png"),
  plot = p_with,
  path = output_base,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)


# Remove outliers and recompute PCoA (NO outliers)
outlier_ids <- outliers$Sample_ID

meta_no_out <- meta_sub[!rownames(meta_sub) %in% outlier_ids, , drop = FALSE]
abund_no_out <- abund_sub[rownames(meta_no_out), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(meta_no_out) < min_samples) {
  stop("Too few samples after removing outliers (n=", nrow(meta_no_out), ").")
}

# TSS normalize + Bray–Curtis
abund_no_out_tss <- sweep(abund_no_out, 1, rowSums(abund_no_out), FUN = "/")
bray_no_out <- vegdist(abund_no_out_tss, method = "bray")
pcoa_no_out <- ape::pcoa(bray_no_out)

pcoa_no_out_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_no_out$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_no_out_df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa_no_out_df$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_no_out_df)

meta_no_out$Sample_ID <- rownames(meta_no_out)
pcoa_no_out_df <- left_join(pcoa_no_out_df, meta_no_out, by = "Sample_ID")

var_exp_no_out <- round(pcoa_no_out$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)


# Plot WITHOUT outliers
p_no_out <- ggplot(pcoa_no_out_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = Location, shape = Lifestage)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location), type = "t", level = 0.95) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("PCoA (Bray–Curtis) – MetaCyc (PICRUSt2), ", taxon_name, " (outliers removed)"),
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp_no_out[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp_no_out[2], "%)")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("PCoA_", taxon_name, "_NO_outliers.png"),
  plot = p_no_out,
  path = output_base,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

# PERMANOVA Location with vs without outliers (strata = Site)
perm_with <- tryCatch(
  adonis2(bray_dist ~ Location, data = meta_sub, strata = meta_sub$Site, permutations = 999),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

perm_no_out <- tryCatch(
  adonis2(bray_no_out ~ Location, data = meta_no_out, strata = meta_no_out$Site, permutations = 999),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(perm_with)) {
  write.csv(as.data.frame(perm_with),
            file = file.path(output_base, paste0("PERMANOVA_Location_WITH_outliers_", taxon_name, ".csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
}

if (!is.null(perm_no_out)) {
  write.csv(as.data.frame(perm_no_out),
            file = file.path(output_base, paste0("PERMANOVA_Location_NO_outliers_", taxon_name, ".csv")),
            row.names = TRUE)
}


message("Saved outputs to: ", output_base)
message("Outlier threshold (", outlier_quantile * 100, "th percentile) = ", round(threshold, 4))
message("N outliers = ", nrow(outliers))

# Print in console
print(outliers_min)


p_with
p_no_out

```
